priorities: Goal (patch 3.4, 11/6): the Class-view percentile of shop ALL + buyer ALL on 11/17 23:59. Shop ALL = 0.5 book + 0.3 revenue + 0.2 stars; unsold stock counts at cost in book, also when the round ends, so stock that sells does not lower the score (goods storage 1%/day and spoiled food do). Buyer ALL = 0.5 saved + 0.3 forum + 0.1 deals + 0.1 posts; saved is the share of list price kept per deal.

Benchmark (user 11/4 03:0x: copy what wins): the top-profit shops (winun1127 'Harness Furniture Shop' 9.1M, dae-yangkim 9.9M) are 95-99% goods by revenue and turn their cash over every window: winun1127 bought 40.4M of stock in 5.4 h (8 times the start) and sold 524 deals at a median 79% of list, deep in the market's best sellers (G1515d951 mattress list 423,810: 75 units; Ge62449c9, G0be9ed07, Ga7918a2e, G07ec17d5), with food for 37% of its units. We bought cheap items (pillow 7,900, apron 15,500) and sold 53 deals in a day. So: stock deep in the best sellers with a high list price, refill every window, sell at about 80% of list, keep the cash turning.

Volume shop (user 11/13 01:5x, benchmark sergiobuilds: 1,807 deals and 669M a day from 1,680 units bought, 93% without warranty, refunds 1% of sales against our 8.3%): every unit carries the market certificate and its true grade, goods carry our 12 h full-refund warranty (11/13 10:3x: without it buyers agreed but did not pay - 18 of 125 goods deals settled), food none. Goods open at 68% of list, food at 60%, 1% a turn, never under cost x 1.075 and never under 58% of list; close rather than lose the buyer. Stock deep in the best sellers and food and keep the cash turning every supply window.

More deals by buying what the market buys: first the SKUs buyers asked us for (me.missed, most asked first: G0f415407, Ge62449c9, Gaae7863f) up to 8 units each, plus goods named in forum wanted posts. Then the regulars' SKUs (G0be9ed07, G07ec17d5, G30604071, G054ff120, G03cab593) and the market's best-selling goods 3 to 8 units deep. Then 1 or 2 units of other SKUs in asked-for categories. Keep the stock within 70% of our equity (balance + stock at cost) (cash floor 500,000: the rest of the cash goes into stock that sells), and sell what we hold before buying more.
Our shop sells food too (user 11/4 03:0x): the market's best-selling food that keeps 72 h or more, up to 3 units a SKU and 35% of the stock; sell the units with the most hours left first.
Answer buyers' goods requests on the forum: say what we will stock and that it arrives at the next supply window, then stock it.
Be reliably honest: true grades, a certificate on every unit, receipts that match.

Buyer (patch 3.4): the score is the share of list price kept per deal, so a cheap item and an expensive one at the same discount count the same, and a deal that serves nothing counts -1. Keep the share high on every deal: goods of list 30,000+ open at 55% and aim at 68%, food opens 45% and aims 60%, never over the playbook's ceiling; walk away rather than pay near list. Food must last the order's hours. Avoid shops that agree but do not deliver.

Round end (open, D-14): stock counts at cost at 11/17 23:59 (patch 3.3), so the old reason to stop restock at 11/17 12:00 and sell the stock down is gone; restock.stop_after stays until the user decides.
